resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because de-duplication matched in-process enrolments that do not yet hold an Aadhaar, at least one of which was a true duplicate or an anomalous match, with no face match anywhere in the candidate set.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment, which requires their biometrics to be unique against both issued Aadhaars and enrolments still in flight. The candidate set contained in-process enrolments that matched fully or partially on biometrics, so this packet could not be treated as a first, unique enrolment and was rejected together with those candidates. The competing enrolment conflict must be adjudicated through the Regional Office.
